title.narrative: In 2024, more than 5,580 migrant children and adolescents were registered to access social protection services and benefits with UNICEF’s support. The Social Assistance main service (PAIF) nearly doubled the coverage in municipalities certified by the initiative Unicef Seal. Through technical assistance to national and subnational governments, capacity-building activities reaching nearly 3,200 social workers and strategic partnerships, UNICEF contributed to enhancing the government&39;s capacity to deliver more inclusive social protection in Brazil.
